snippet.title: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Available to wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/5100510/Heart_Harvest_A_Detective_Game/

Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls.
Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game
Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..
